mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ct_gm.t_od_order_item(dept_id, order_id, item_no, style_id, style_code, color, size, qty, unit_price, amount, tax_rate, delivery_date_plan, qty_shipped, tech_desc, remark, created_at, updated_at, created_by, is_del) VALUES (#{entity.deptId}, #{entity.orderId}, #{entity.itemNo}, #{entity.styleId}, #{entity.styleCode}, #{entity.color}, #{entity.size}, #{entity.qty}, #{entity.unitPrice}, #{entity.amount}, #{entity.taxRate}, #{entity.deliveryDatePlan}, #{entity.qtyShipped}, #{entity.techDesc}, #{entity.remark}, NOW(), NOW(), #{createdBy}, 0)
mapper.update: UPDATE ct_gm.t_od_order_item SET item_no=#{entity.itemNo}, style_id=#{entity.styleId}, style_code=#{entity.styleCode}, color=#{entity.color}, size=#{entity.size}, qty=#{entity.qty}, unit_price=#{entity.unitPrice}, amount=#{entity.amount}, tax_rate=#{entity.taxRate}, delivery_date_plan=#{entity.deliveryDatePlan}, qty_shipped=#{entity.qtyShipped}, tech_desc=#{entity.techDesc}, remark=#{entity.remark}, updated_at=NOW() WHERE order_item_id = #{entity.id} AND is_del = 0
UPDATE ct_gm.t_od_order_item SET item_no=item_no+10000 WHERE order_id=#{orderId} AND is_del=0
UPDATE ct_gm.t_od_order_item SET is_del=1,updated_at=NOW() WHERE order_item_id=#{itemId} AND is_del=0
mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(oi.qty * COALESCE(mc.cost, 0)), 0) FROM ct_gm.t_od_order_item oi LEFT JOIN (SELECT sm.style_id, SUM(sm.unit_consume * (1 + sm.loss_rate) * m.std_price) AS cost FROM ct_gm.t_sys_style_material sm JOIN ct_gm.t_sys_material m ON m.material_id=sm.material_id AND m.is_del=0 WHERE sm.is_del=0 GROUP BY sm.style_id) mc ON mc.style_id=oi.style_id WHERE oi.order_id=#{orderId} AND oi.is_del=0

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(oi.qty * COALESCE(pc.cost, 0)), 0) FROM ct_gm.t_od_order_item oi LEFT JOIN (SELECT sp.style_id, SUM(sp.piece_price * sp.difficulty_rate) AS cost FROM ct_gm.t_sys_style_process sp WHERE sp.is_del=0 AND sp.status=1 GROUP BY sp.style_id) pc ON pc.style_id=oi.style_id WHERE oi.order_id=#{orderId} AND oi.is_del=0

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(sm.unit_consume * (1 + sm.loss_rate) * m.std_price), 0) FROM ct_gm.t_sys_style_material sm JOIN ct_gm.t_sys_material m ON m.material_id=sm.material_id AND m.is_del=0 WHERE sm.style_id=#{styleId} AND sm.is_del=0
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(sp.piece_price * sp.difficulty_rate), 0) FROM ct_gm.t_sys_style_process sp WHERE sp.style_id=#{styleId} AND sp.is_del=0 AND sp.status=1
